w19.pm_title: Help us tailor HHF to your setup (2-minute questionnaire)
w19.pm_body:
Hi @{{USERNAME}}, quick note from the HHF Technology team, and thanks for being part of the forum.

We've added a short questionnaire so we can point you to the guides and tools that fit your setup: what you run, the tunnels and proxies you use, and anything you're stuck on. Only staff see your answers, and nothing goes on your profile unless you tick that box.

You can also show your stack (Pangolin, Traefik, CrowdSec, the AI tools you use and more) on your profile and user card: [add it here]({{BASE_URL}}/my/preferences/profile).

This is a one-time message. If you'd rather not get onboarding messages, [opt out here]({{BASE_URL}}/workflows/form/eb2de0bc-2150-4a92-ab4d-43b8685cb97a) and we won't message you about it again.

**Your next step:** [open the questionnaire]({{BASE_URL}}/workflows/form/2d340c3d-9d99-407b-82a3-2e5e33167844). It takes about 2 minutes.

Thanks,
HHF Technology
